instrument: Escape-clause tariff-rate quota on stainless steel table flatware (69 million units a year from 1 Nov 1959; over-quota rates up to 17.5 per cent plus specific duty)
legal_basis: Trade Agreements Extension Act 1951 s.7 (escape clause); Proclamation 3323
source: Proclamation 3323 of 22 Oct 1959, 24 FR 8625 (24 Oct 1959); Tariff Commission supplemental report, 24 FR (29 Jul 1959)
note: Instrument verified at source. Global quota: Japan is NOT named in the proclamation or the Tariff Commission notices; Japan's supplier share not checked. Tariff Commission still reviewing the restriction in Sep 1967 (32 FR 13684); end year unverified. Single-product TRQ, so IR 4 only under the register's motorcycle (B-11) practice.

instrument: Bilateral cotton textile agreement with Japan (signed 12 Jan 1968; covers 1967 and three years from 1 Jan 1968; aggregate 373.1 million sq yd)
legal_basis: bilateral agreement under the LTA
source: State Department summary of LTA actions, 33 FR (23 Jan 1968) pp. 828-829; USITC Pub. 850 (1978) p. 49
note: FR: 'A bilateral agreement covering cotton textile exports from Japan during 1967, and for the 3 years beginning January 1, 1968, was signed on January 12, 1968.' Pub. 850: 1963 agreement ran 3 years and was extended 2 years; new 3-year agreement from 1 Jan 1968; then a 1-year lapse (1971).

instrument: Bilateral cotton textile agreement with Japan (21 months from 1 Jan 1972, extended one year; initial limit 463.4 million sq yd)
legal_basis: bilateral agreement under the LTA
source: USITC Pub. 850 (1978) p. 49
status: verified (USITC report; FR notice not located)
note: Separate from B-04 (wool and man-made fibre agreement from 1 Oct 1971). Japan administered its limits by export licensing, so no CITA directives for Japan appear in the FR sample for 1969-1976. Signature date not seen; end = Sep 1974 by Pub. 850 arithmetic.

instrument: Comprehensive MFA agreement with Japan (cotton, wool, man-made fibre; 3 1/4 years from 1 Oct 1974; aggregate 1.7 billion sq yd)
legal_basis: bilateral agreement under the MFA (1974)
source: USITC Pub. 850 (1978) pp. 1 and 49
status: verified (USITC report; FR notice not located)
note: Pub. 850: aggregate and cotton limits suspended 1 Oct 1975-30 Sep 1976; a later amendment eliminated all specific limits and left a consultation mechanism. So binding sector-wide limits only Oct 1974-Sep 1975 (IR 4); afterwards consultation (IR 2-3). Signature date not seen.

instrument: Bilateral cotton, wool and man-made fibre textile agreement with Japan of 17 Aug 1979 (consultation mechanism; US calls in 1984 led to agreed limits on Cat. 631pt work gloves and 634 coats in 1985)
legal_basis: bilateral agreement under the MFA (1977 protocol)
source: CITA notice of 31 May 1985, 50 FR 23756 (5 Jun 1985), citing calls in 49 FR 40076 and 41269 (Oct 1984); consultation calls 49 FR (9 Mar 1984, Cats 314, 604, 644)
note: Agreement date verified from the 1985 notice. Text and term of the 1979 agreement not seen; no CITA limits on Japan found in the FR for 1977-1983 (targeted phrase search). Binding limits only on a few called categories, so IR 4 doubtful (lower rung 3). End year = last year before the 1986 unilateral limits; unverified.

instrument: Unilateral US import limits on Japanese textiles after failed consultations (Cats 314, 341/641, 613 from 30 Apr 1986; Cats 310/318, 315/320pt, 317pt, 347/348 from 30 Jun 1986)
legal_basis: MFA Art. 3; Agricultural Act 1956 s.204; EO 11651 (CITA)
source: CITA notices 51 FR 23808 (1 Jul 1986) and 51 FR 32819 (16 Sep 1986); calls 51 FR 19245 and 51 FR 26920 (28 Jul 1986)
note: FR: 'inasmuch as consultations with the Government of Japan failed to reach a mutually satisfactory solution ... to control imports' at stated levels for twelve months from 30 Apr 1986. Superseded by the agreement of 6 Feb 1987 (next row). Seven categories of fabric and apparel: IR 4 or 3 (lower rule gives 3).

instrument: Bilateral cotton, wool and man-made fibre textile agreement with Japan of 6 Feb 1987 (group limits for apparel, non-apparel and MMF yarn, 1 Jan 1986-31 Dec 1989)
legal_basis: bilateral agreement under the MFA (1986 protocol)
source: CITA notice of 20 Feb 1987, 52 FR (27 Feb 1987); 1988 limits 52 FR 49470 (31 Dec 1987); 1989 limits 53 FR (12 Dec 1988)
note: FR: 'On February 6, 1987, the Governments of the United States and Japan reached agreement on a new bilateral agreement ... establishes annual group limits ... during the period January 1, 1986 and extending through December 31, 1989.' Page number of the Feb 1987 notice not read.

instrument: Bilateral cotton, wool and man-made fibre textile agreement with Japan by exchange of notes of 21 Jun 1991 (two one-year periods, 1 Jan 1990-31 Dec 1991)
legal_basis: bilateral agreement under the MFA
source: CITA notice of 30 Jul 1991, 56 FR (5 Aug 1991)
note: Limits effective 8 Aug 1991 for the new agreement year. No CITA limits on Japan found for 1992-2004 (govinfo phrase search 1991-1994; federalregister.gov CITA listing 1994-2005 shows only visa notices for Japan): end 1991, continuation after 1991 unverified.

instrument: Comprehensive bilateral cotton textile agreement with Korea of 11 Dec 1967 (1 Jan 1967-31 Dec 1970, briefly extended)
legal_basis: bilateral agreement under the LTA
source: ITAC notice of 13 Dec 1967, 32 FR (19 Dec 1967); State Department summary 33 FR 828-829 (23 Jan 1968); USITC Pub. 850 p. 49
note: FR: notes 'constituting a comprehensive United States-Republic of Korea cotton textile agreement covering the period January 1, 1967-December 31, 1970, were exchanged on December 11, 1967'. Superseded the 3-year agreement of 26 Jan 1965 (already in the B-02 note). Pub. 850: 'after a short extension' replaced from 1 Oct 1971.

instrument: Bilateral cotton textile agreement with Korea of 30 Dec 1971 (4 3/4 years from 1 Oct 1971; FR directive for 1 Jan-30 Sep 1972)
legal_basis: bilateral agreement under the LTA
source: Cabinet Textile Advisory Committee directive of 30 Dec 1971, 37 FR (6 Jan 1972); USITC Pub. 850 p. 50
note: Cotton counterpart of the wool and MMF agreement of 4 Jan 1972 (B-04). Pub. 850 gives effect from 1 Oct 1971; consolidated into the MFA agreement effective 1 Oct 1974 (next row), so end 1974.

instrument: Bilateral cotton, wool and man-made fibre textile agreement with Korea of 26 Jun 1975 (consolidated three-fibre agreement, three years from 1 Oct 1974; aggregate 504.7 million sq yd)
legal_basis: bilateral agreement under the MFA (1974)
source: CITA letters of 1 and 2 Jul 1975, 40 FR 28123-28124 (3 Jul 1975), cited in 40 FR (29 Aug 1975); USITC Pub. 850 p. 50
note: Signed 26 Jun 1975 with retroactive effect from 1 Oct 1974 (specific limits for the year beginning 1 Oct 1974). Pub. 850: expiring 30 Sep 1977 and extended by a month pending a new agreement.

instrument: Bilateral cotton, wool and man-made fibre textile agreement with Korea of 23 Dec 1977 (new category system; from 1 Jan 1978)
legal_basis: bilateral agreement under the MFA (1977 protocol)
source: CITA directive of 23 Dec 1977, 42 FR (29 Dec 1977); clarification 43 FR (30 May 1978)
note: Effective 1 Jan 1978. Term not seen; the agreement is still cited for the year beginning 1 Jan 1982 (47 FR 30 Nov/1 Dec 1982) until the agreement of Dec 1982 applied retroactively to 1982. End 1981 therefore partly inferred.

instrument: Bilateral cotton, wool and man-made fibre textile agreement with Korea signed 14 Dec 1982 (also cited as of 1 Dec 1982; levels for 1982 and from 1 Jan 1983)
legal_basis: bilateral agreement under the MFA (1981 protocol)
source: CITA notices 47 FR 57984 (29 Dec 1982) and 47 FR (30 Dec 1982); calls under it e.g. 48 FR (10 Nov 1983)
note: FR: 'On December 14, 1982, the Governments of the United States and the Republic of Korea signed an agreement'. Later notices cite it as 'agreement of December 1, 1982'. End 1985 because the 1986 agreement covers 1986; term of the 1982 agreement not seen.

instrument: Bilateral textile agreement with Korea by exchange of notes of 21 Nov and 4 Dec 1986 (group and individual limits from 1 Jan 1986; amended and extended to 1994)
legal_basis: bilateral agreement under the MFA (1986 protocol)
source: CITA directive 52 FR 1520 (14 Jan 1987); still in force 1994: FR Doc 94-1137, 59 FR (18 Jan 1994)
note: Superseded by ATC limits from 1 Jan 1995 (next row; 60 FR 17328 says the ATC limits supersede this agreement).

instrument: ATC import restraint limits on Korean textiles and apparel (limits notified to the TMB, 1995-2004)
legal_basis: WTO Agreement on Textiles and Clothing; Uruguay Round Agreements Act; Agricultural Act 1956 s.204
source: CITA notice 60 FR 17328 (5 Apr 1995), FR Doc 95-8294; last limits 68 FR 59919 (20 Oct 2003) for 2004; visa cancellation 69 FR (17 Dec 2004) 04-27789
note: Same legal regime as B-31 for TW/HK/TH/MY/BR. Limits 'agreed upon by the Governments of the United States and the Republic of Korea, as notified to the Uruguay Round Textiles Monitoring Body'. Quotas ended with the ATC on 1 Jan 2005.

instrument: Line pipe safeguard: additional duty above 9,000 short tons per supplying country (Canada and Mexico excluded)
legal_basis: Section 201 (TA-201-70); Proclamation 7274
source: Proclamation 7274 of 18 Feb 2000, 65 FR 9193 (23 Feb 2000); USITC case statistics Table 14 (case 70)
note: Instrument verified: effective 1 Mar 2000 for 3 years and 1 day. Korea is NOT named in the proclamation (per-country in-quota exclusion for all suppliers); naming Korea follows only in Proclamation 7585 (next row). Single-product TRQ.

instrument: Korea-specific line pipe tariff-rate quota under an agreement signed 29 Jul 2002 (replaces the 9,000-ton exclusion for Korea from 1 Sep 2002)
legal_basis: Section 201 / 203(a)(3)(E) and 203(f); Proclamation 7585
source: Proclamation 7585 of 28 Aug 2002, 67 FR 56207-56210 (30 Aug 2002)
note: FR: USTR 'negotiated an agreement with the Republic of Korea ... limiting the export from Korea and import into the United States of line pipe through the imposition of a tariff-rate quota, to take effect on September 1, 2002. The agreement was signed on July 29, 2002.' Relief ended 1 Mar 2003 (Proclamation 7274 annex). Single product: IR 4 only under the B-11 practice.

instrument: Steel voluntary restraint (quota) agreement with the People's Republic of China under the President's Steel Program
legal_basis: President's Steel Program; Steel Import Stabilization Act 1984 (Title VIII)
source: USITC Pub. 1953 (Feb 1987): no agreement yet, talks continuing; USITC Pub. 1984 (Jun 1987) and Pub. 2007 (Sep 1987): China listed under 'Quota agreements' for 1987; USITC Pub. 2182 (May 1989) p. 1-1 lists China among VRA countries
note: Existence verified in USITC reports; signature month unverified (between Feb and Jun 1987). Not found in govinfo FR searches. End 1992 assumes the extension of the programme to 31 Mar 1992 covered China: unverified. Pub. 2182: China's VRA not binding in 1987.

instrument: US-China bilateral textile agreement (MOU of 1 Feb 1997; cotton, wool, MMF, silk blend and other vegetable fibre limits 1997-2000, amended 31 Oct 2000 to cover 2001; silk apparel agreement for 1997)
legal_basis: bilateral MOU; Agricultural Act 1956 s.204; EO 11651 (CITA)
source: CITA notice 62 FR 6950-6953 (14 Feb 1997), FR Doc 97-3708; 2001 limits 65 FR (27 Dec 2000), FR Doc 00-32987
note: FR: MOU dated 1 Feb 1997; textile agreement 'for a four-year period, through December 31, 2000'; extended by amendment of 31 Oct 2000 for 2001. Successor of B-49 (1994 MOU, 1994-1996).

instrument: ATC-based import limits on Chinese textiles and apparel after WTO accession (stages 1-3 integrated; quotas 2002-2004)
legal_basis: WTO Agreement on Textiles and Clothing (China's accession); Agricultural Act 1956 s.204
source: CITA notice 66 FR 67229-67232 (28 Dec 2001), FR Doc 01-31860; 2003 limits 67 FR (16 Oct 2002); 2004 limits 68 FR (20 Nov 2003)
note: FR: 2002 limits 'based on limits to be notified to the Textiles Monitoring Body pursuant to the ... ATC'. Quotas ended 31 Dec 2004; then para. 242 safeguards (IR 3, not added) and the 2005 MOU (B-50).
